name: Bluetooth Low Energy in the background
plain: Apps can keep talking to Bluetooth devices when closed, with strict scan rules on iOS.
meaning: Used by wearables, trackers and beacons. iOS wakes apps for known peripherals; Android needs a foreground service or a companion device grant to scan reliably.

android.store_policy: Play: BLUETOOTH_SCAN used for location needs declaration
android.note: Background scans are throttled; Doze limits scanning; companion device apps exempt from several limits

ios.persistence: Wakes the app on events for peripherals it connected to; scanning in background needs service UUIDs and coalesces results
ios.note: Background scans must specify service UUIDs; duplicate advertisements coalesced; state preservation relaunches the app

limits.headline: Can keep talking to Bluetooth gadgets with the app closed, with strict scan rules
limits.user_action: You tap Allow for Bluetooth and connect a device, then leave the app
can: Stay connected to a paired Bluetooth gadget
Get data from a watch, lock or tracker in the background
Wake the app on iPhone when the gadget sends something
Scan for devices in the background, at a slower pace
cannot: Scan freely in the background on iPhone; you must name service UUIDs
Scan without limits in the background on Android; Doze and throttling slow it
Use Bluetooth if you tap Don't Allow
limits.differs: iPhone requires UUID filtered background scans and can relaunch the app. Android throttles scans and exempts companion device apps.

story.what_it_is: An app keeps talking to Bluetooth gadgets when it is closed.

marketing.name: Core Bluetooth background
marketing.pitch: Apple lets apps connect to and get data from Bluetooth devices in the background.

marketing.name: Bluetooth Low Energy
marketing.pitch: Android apps can connect to low power Bluetooth devices, with rules for background scans.

story.for_you: You walk up to your car or your smart lock and it works, with no app open. Your fitness band keeps syncing. You never need to launch the app first.
story.for_makers: Makers of wearables, trackers and locks need this for the product to feel automatic. It also lets beacons notice you when you pass a shop. Platforms limit scans to protect battery and privacy.

use_cases.example: A fitness band syncs steps to the app while the phone is in your pocket.
A smart lock senses your phone as you approach and unlocks the door.
A digital car key lets you unlock the car when you walk up.
A store beacon wakes the app when you walk in and offers a coupon.
A glucose monitor sends readings to the phone all day.
A tracker uses nearby Bluetooth beacons to learn how long you stay somewhere.

story.android_note: Android needs a foreground service or a companion device grant to scan reliably in the background.
story.ios_note: iPhone wakes an app for known devices and has strict rules on background scans.

technical_bounds: Scan filters required in iOS background

history.change: Nearby devices permissions BLUETOOTH_SCAN and BLUETOOTH_CONNECT
